edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC3 Caller without the Documents right (exception X2, BR7)
    Given "AUD-0001" holds no Documents right on case "RC-2026-000321"
    When "AUD-0001" sends the POST on case "RC-2026-000321"
    Then the system returns 403 with MSG-P4-002
    Then nothing is written

  Scenario: AC4 Request id unknown or case outside scope (exception X3, BR9)
    Given the request id is unknown or the case is outside the scope of the caller
    When the caller asks for the answer
    Then the system returns 404 with the platform not-found envelope
    Then no index entry and no document reference is returned

  Scenario: AC5 Case reference missing from the POST (exception X4, BR9)
    Given the POST carries no case reference
    When the POST is sent
    Then the system returns 422 with MSG-GEN-001
    Then no request row is created

  Scenario: AC6 Notice without a document (exception X5, BR5)
    Given a notice of the case has no document yet
    When the answer is requested
    Then the index entry is returned with its document reference empty
    Then the answer is not refused
    And the index entry carries only the TSD P6 T3.1 fields DF-LEG-015 to DF-LEG-023

  Scenario: AC7 rwb-document read does not answer inside 2 s (exception X6, BR11)
    Given the rwb-document contract does not answer inside 2 s
    When the answer is requested
    Then the answer is not returned and the request stays OPENED
    Then the rwb-document read is retried once with jitter
    Then no partial answer is returned as complete

  Scenario: AC8 Produced copy cannot be read (exception X7, BR11)
    Given the produced copy of document "DOC-0101" cannot be read from the store
    When the answer is requested
    Then the document line is returned with its reference and a pending state
    Then the caller is told the copy is not yet available

  Scenario: AC9 Repeat with one Idempotency-Key (exception X8, BR10)
    Given the POST was answered with status 201 for one Idempotency-Key
    When the same POST is repeated with that Idempotency-Key
    Then the first answer is returned with status 201
    Then no second request exists

  Scenario: AC10 Document facts carried unchanged (BR2)
    Given the rwb-document contract returns document "DOC-0101" with its origin, entry date, alteration flag and readers
    When the answer is requested
    Then the document line carries those facts exactly as rwb-document returns them
    Then this service rewrites none of them

  Scenario: AC11 Answer stored and read back unchanged (BR4)
    Given an answer has been stored as answered
    When the answer is read back
    Then the answer is returned unchanged and no value is recomputed

  Scenario: AC12 Notice type and delivery status from the lists in force (BR6)
    Given the lists LOV-NOTICE and LOV-DELIVERY have a version in force
    When the answer is requested
    Then the notice type and delivery status values are read from those lists
    Then no value is written in code

  Scenario: AC13 Request opened per case only (BR8)
    Given the POST names case "RC-2026-000321"
    When the POST is sent
    Then the request is opened for that case only
    Then no selector across cases is accepted

  Scenario: AC14 Reads on the owner contracts only (BR12)
    Given the notice rows and the request rows are rwb_comms rows
    When the answer is requested
    Then the notice is read from rwb_comms
    Then the document is read on the rwb-document contract and never from its tables

  Scenario: AC15 Legal hold respected (BR13)
    Given document "DOC-0101" is under a legal hold
    When the answer is requested
    Then the preserved document is read
    Then this story writes no custody, retention or hold fact

  Scenario: AC16 No personal data in the answer (BR14)
    Given the answer is produced for case "RC-2026-000321"
    When the answer is requested
    Then the answer carries notice ids, case ids, document ids, document types, barcodes, dates and status codes only
